package hiddencheck

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestHiddenQueue(t *testing.T) {
	body, err := os.ReadFile("../ANSWER.txt")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(body)), "\n")
	if len(lines) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("%d lines, want 2", len(lines))
	}
	if got := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(lines[1]), "\"`"); got != "orders-express" {
		t.Fatalf("queue line %q", lines[1])
	}
}
